model.title: Science of Reading Act of 2026
model.meta: Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Erin Houchin (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would modify a federal grant program for literacy instruction to require that funded programs align with "science of reading" principles—emphasizing phonics, phonemic awareness, vocabulary, fluency, and comprehension—while explicitly excluding instructional methods that rely primarily on context clues or visual memory for word recognition. It aims to direct federal education funding toward evidence-based reading instruction approaches supported by research.
